steps.title: Tell us what it's doing
steps.desc: Blowing warm, tripping the breaker, draining slow, heat that won't fire — or a system that just hasn't been cleaned in two summers. Pick it, pick your home size, say how soon you need someone. Under a minute, no sign-up, works on any phone.

steps.title: See clean, repair or replace
steps.desc: An honest range built on Military City's own pricing. Most units fail on dirt and neglect long before they fail on age, so a cleaning shows up as a cleaning — not as a replacement quote in disguise.

steps.title: Pick your service window
steps.desc: Choose a slot from the real schedule and you're confirmed on the spot. A licensed tech shows up, confirms the diagnosis, and gives you the final price before any work starts.
